snippet.title: Kyoto Xanadu – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 2.5.2026
snippet.description:
Kyoto Xanadu is coming in summer 2026 to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch.

Dive deep beneath Kyoto, Japan to beat the monsters and mysteries awaiting in Xanadu in this brand-new action RPG!

#KyotoXanadu #Falcom #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
